Title: Create a new order with measurement group photos and verify they are stored and returned in the response
Section: Order Management: Order Creation with Measurement Group Photos
Preconditions: A shop exists in the system. Items with IDs 1 (Shirt) and 2 (Pant) are available. Customer details are ready for input.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the order summary with fields: orderId (non-null number), shopName, customerName, customerPhone, totalAmount, paidAmount, dueAmount, itemCount (2), and itemName. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the full order details, including measurementGroups with photoUrl fields populated (e.g., 'orders/measurement_shirt_123.jpg' and 'orders/measurement_pant_123.jpg') for each measurement group.

Title: Retrieve an existing order and verify measurement group photos are displayed correctly
Section: Order Management: Order Retrieval with Measurement Group Photos
Preconditions: An order with ID 123 exists in the system, containing at least one item with measurement groups that include photo URLs.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the order details, including items with measurementGroups. Each measurementGroup must include an id and photoUrl field (e.g., 'orders/measurement_12345.jpg') that is non-null and accessible.

Title: Create a new order without measurement group photos and verify no photo URLs are returned
Section: Order Management: Order Creation with Missing Measurement Group Photos
Preconditions: A shop exists in the system. Items with IDs 1 (Shirt) and 2 (Pant) are available. Customer details are ready for input.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the order summary. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the full order details, including measurementGroups with photoUrl fields either null or absent for each measurement group.

Title: Attempt to retrieve order details using a non-existent order ID
Preconditions: No order exists in the system with ID 99999.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/orders/99999.

Test Data: Path variable: id = 99999
Expected Result: The request is rejected and returns an error response indicating 'Order not found with ID: 99999'.

Title: Create an order with an empty measurements list in a measurement group and retrieve it by ID
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists and an item with ID 101 exists.
Expected Result: The POST request returns HTTP status code 200 OK with an OrderSummaryResponse. The GET request to /api/orders/{id} returns HTTP status code 200 OK with an OrderResponse body where items[0].measurementGroups[0].photoUrl is "http://example.com/item.jpg" and items[0].measurementGroups[0].measurements is an empty array [].

Title: Create an order with null photoUrl in measurement group request and verify response payload
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists and an item with ID 101 exists.
Expected Result: The POST request succeeds with HTTP status code 200 OK. The GET request returns HTTP status code 200 OK where items[0].measurementGroups[0].photoUrl is null and items[0].measurementGroups[0].measurements[0].value is 40.0.
